name: Ben Garvey
title: Founder and CEO, Great Lakes Gaming
quote: Elliot interned for us at GLG Summer of 2022 and we continue to hire him on commission for various projects requiring 3D modeling and animation. Elliot has performed beyond expectations on many major projects for us. Cannot recommend Elliot enough for his talent and willingness to learn, improve and create some beautiful pieces of art.

name: Barry Strauber
title: Professor, Rochester Institute of Technology
quote:
Elliot Gong is an exceptional student and I had the great privilege to be his teacher. His maturity was unique and wonderful. His ability to dissect a problem was/is great and valued.
And his mind enables him to easily tackle more problems that come up. I highly recommend Elliot for a multitude of many jobs.
